preparation_steps.description: Prepare the mineral-medium base with the source-specific mineral inputs; add the vitamins separately after heat sterilization.
Adjust pH if specified in original formulation
Heat-sterilize the mineral medium at 120 C before adding the filter-sterilized vitamins. The inspected source passage does not specify hold time or pressure.
Add the filter-sterilized vitamins after heat sterilization, at the source-stated final vitamin concentrations. Filtration pore size and addition temperature are not specified.

curation_history.notes: Replaced 13 legacy mediaingredientmech_term link(s) with mediaingredientmech_chebi_term (id-safe: ingredient's own CHEBI + label). MIM deprecated the MediaIngredientMech:NNNNNN id scheme.

Re-grounded 2 term reference(s) to the correct CHEBI (see reports/chebi_grounding_audit.md). Label-conditional fixes for pyridoxine/pyridoxamine, glycerol, MnSO4, Ca(NO3)2, selenate; casamino acids de-grounded (mixture, no single CHEBI).

Restored the medium's own name in media_term.term.label, original_name. The MediaDB SQL parser truncated every value containing a parenthesis at that parenthesis; recovered from media_database.07Oct2015.sql.

Reviewed source-specific ingredient changes. Two papers, four formulations; carbon source dose and batch/chemostat stage must not be conflated. Twenty-six mineral amounts have an explicit water-input/final-volume boundary; two molybdate claims have a printed formula conflict. Seven vitamin amounts per record are final concentrations; both papers directly report para-aminobenzoic acid 0.2 mg/L, not the database 0.1458 mM assertion. The omitted silicone antifoam is 0.025 mL per liter of medium in 1992; 0.05 mL per liter water input in 1996. No density or final-volume conversion is inferred. Existing ethanol parent/child notes saying only ethanol differs must be qualified when source antifoam and experimental-stage evidence is applied. Paper-specific benzoate treatments are not a fixed universal basal ingredient dose. DOI identity checked against PubMed; DOI resolver web attempts failed. Downloaded repository PDFs and page images provide the inspected concentration evidence. No automatic reference-validator pass, numeric equivalence of old conversions, exhaustive growth review, or new organism association is asserted.

Re-grounded 2 term reference(s) to the correct CHEBI (see reports/chebi_grounding_audit.md). Label-conditional fixes for pyridoxine/pyridoxamine, glycerol, MnSO4, Ca(NO3)2, selenate; casamino acids de-grounded (mixture, no single CHEBI).

Restored the medium's own name in media_term.term.label, original_name. The MediaDB SQL parser truncated every value containing a parenthesis at that parenthesis; recovered from media_database.07Oct2015.sql.

Reviewed source-specific ingredient changes. Two papers, four formulations; carbon source dose and batch/chemostat stage must not be conflated. Twenty-six mineral amounts have an explicit water-input/final-volume boundary; two molybdate claims have a printed formula conflict. Seven vitamin amounts per record are final concentrations; both papers directly report para-aminobenzoic acid 0.2 mg/L, not the database 0.1458 mM assertion. The omitted silicone antifoam is 0.025 mL per liter of medium in 1992; 0.05 mL per liter water input in 1996. No density or final-volume conversion is inferred. Existing ethanol parent/child notes saying only ethanol differs must be qualified when source antifoam and experimental-stage evidence is applied. Paper-specific benzoate treatments are not a fixed universal basal ingredient dose. DOI identity checked against PubMed; DOI resolver web attempts failed. Downloaded repository PDFs and page images provide the inspected concentration evidence. No automatic reference-validator pass, numeric equivalence of old conversions, exhaustive growth review, or new organism association is asserted.

Reviewed source-specific ingredient changes. Two papers, four formulations; carbon source dose and batch/chemostat stage must not be conflated. Twenty-six mineral amounts have an explicit water-input/final-volume boundary; two molybdate claims have a printed formula conflict. Seven vitamin amounts per record are final concentrations; both papers directly report para-aminobenzoic acid 0.2 mg/L, not the database 0.1458 mM assertion. The omitted silicone antifoam is 0.025 mL per liter of medium in 1992; 0.05 mL per liter water input in 1996. No density or final-volume conversion is inferred. Existing ethanol parent/child notes saying only ethanol differs must be qualified when source antifoam and experimental-stage evidence is applied. Paper-specific benzoate treatments are not a fixed universal basal ingredient dose. DOI identity checked against PubMed; DOI resolver web attempts failed. Downloaded repository PDFs and page images provide the inspected concentration evidence. No automatic reference-validator pass, numeric equivalence of old conversions, exhaustive growth review, or new organism association is asserted.

complete_preparation_context.name: snow_algae_medium
complete_preparation_context.description: Algae culture medium from UTEX Culture Collection. Suitable for freshwater algae cultivation.
complete_preparation_context.notes: UTEX prepares Snow Algae Medium at pH 5.1-5.3 from a defined freshwater salt base with FE EDTA and Minor Nutrients added at source-stated volumes.

preparation_steps.description: To approximately 500 mL dH2O, add each component in the UTEX order while stirring continuously.

preparation_steps.description: Adjust pH to 3.0.

Dissolve ingredients except FeSO4・7H2O, yeast extract and 10 N H2SO4 in 700 ml distilled water and autoclave. Separately dissolve FeSO4・7H2O in 300 ml distilled water with 10 N H2SO4 and autoclave at 110C for 30 min. After cooling, mix the both solutions. Before inoculation, add yeast extract from a sterile stock solution (10%). Checkthe final pH to be 1.5 -- 2.0.
